ayahs.translationClear: “O Abraham, refrain from this. The command of your Lord has come; they have incurred an irreversible punishment.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوْطًا سِيْ࢜ءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَّقَالَ هٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort[568] and said, "This is a trying day."
ayahs.transliteration: Walammaa jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wadaaqa bihim dhar'an waqaala haadhaa yawmun 'aseeb

footnotes.568: Prophet Lot feared for the safety and honor of his guests.

ayahs.translationClear: And when Our envoys came to Lot, he was anxious for them, and concerned for them. He said, “This is a dreadful day.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ‌ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ‌ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ‌ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَا࢜ءَهٗ قَوْمُهٗ يُهْرَعُوْنَ اِلَيْهِؕ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ بَنَاتِيْ هُنَّ اَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخْزُوْنِ فِيْ ضَيْفِيْؕ اَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds.[569] He said, "O my people, these are my daughters;[570] they are purer for you. So fear Allāh and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wajaa'ahoo qawmuhoo yuhra'oona ilayhi wamin qablu kaanoo ya'maloonas-sayyi'aati qaala yaaqawmi haa'ulaa'i banaatee hunna at'haru lakum fattaqullaaha walaa tukhzooni fee dayfee alaysa minkum rajulur rasheed

footnotes.569: Referring to their practice of sodomy and homosexual rape of males.
footnotes.570: i.e., the women of his community who were available for marriage.

ayahs.translationClear: And his people came rushing towards him—they were in the habit of committing sins. He said, “O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah, and do not embarrass me before my guests. Is there not one reasonable man among you?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِيْ بَنٰتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّۚ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters [i.e., women] any claim [i.e., desire], and indeed, you know what we want."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo laqad 'alimta maa lanaa fee banaatika min haqqin wa'innaka lata'lamu maa nureed
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “You know well that we have no right to your daughters, and you know well what we want.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِيْ بِكُمْ قُوَّةً اَوْ اٰوِيْٓ اِلٰي رُكْنٍ شَدِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw aawee ilaa ruknin shadeed
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “If only I had the strength to stop you, or could rely on some strong support.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ‌ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ‌ۚ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا يٰلُوْطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَّصِلُوْٓا اِلَيْكَ فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ الَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَكَؕ اِنَّهٗ مُصِيْبُهَا مَا͏ٓ اَصَابَهُمْؕ اِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُؕ اَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيْبٍ
ayahs.translation: They [the angels] said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night[571] and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaalootu innaa rusulu rabbika lan yasiloo ilayka fa'asri bi'ahlika biqit'im minal-layli walaa yaltafit minkum ahadun illamra'ataka innahoo museebuhaa maa asaabahum inna maw'idahumus-subhu alaysas-subhu biqareeb
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “O Lot, we are the envoys of your Lord; they will not reach you. So set out with your family during the cover of the night, and let none of you look back, except for your wife. She will be struck by what will strike them. Their appointed time is the morning. Is not the morning near?”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَ اَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّنْ سِجِّيْلٍ࣢ۙ مَّنْضُوْدٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa ja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa'amtarnaa 'alayhaa hijaaratam min sijjeelim mandood
ayahs.translationClear: And when Our command came about, We turned it upside down, and We rained down on it stones of baked clay.

ayahs.textUthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا هِىَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ‌ۖ وَمَا هِىَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ بِبَعِيْدٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Marked from your Lord. And it [i.e., Allāh's punishment] is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.
ayahs.transliteration: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika wamaa hiya minaz-zaalimeena biba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: Marked from your Lord, and never far from the wrongdoers.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۚ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا‌ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ‌ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ‌ۚ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِلٰي مَدْيَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهٗؕ وَلَا تَنْقُصُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيْزَانَ اِنِّيْٓ اَرٰىكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ وَّاِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيْطٍ
ayahs.translation: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'ayban qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhoo walaa tanqusul-mikyaala wal-meezaana innee araakum bikhayrin wa'innee akhaafu 'alaykum 'adhaaba yawmim muheet
ayahs.translationClear: And to Midian, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. And do not short measure or short weight. I see you in good circumstances, but I fear for you the agony of an encompassing Day.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ‌ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيٰقَوْمِ اَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيْزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَا࢜ءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaaqawmi awful-mikyaala wal-meezaana bil-qisti walaa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
ayahs.translationClear: “O my people! Give full measure and full weight, in all fairness, and do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not spread corruption in the land.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ‌ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: بَقِيَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ࣢ۚ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيْظٍ
ayahs.translation: What remains [lawful] from Allāh is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."
ayahs.transliteration: Baqiyyatullaahi khayrul lakum in kuntum mu'mineena wamaa ana 'alaykum bihafeez
ayahs.translationClear: What is left by Allah is best for you, if you are believers. And I am not a guardian over you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟‌ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا يٰشُعَيْبُ اَصَلٰوتُكَ تَاْمُرُكَ اَنْ نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ اٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُنَا͏ٓ اَوْ اَنْ نَّفْعَلَ فِيْٓ اَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُاؕ اِنَّكَ لَاَنْتَ الْحَلِيْمُ الرَّشِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"[572]
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaashu'aybu asalaatuka ta'muruka an natruka maa ya'budu aabaa'unaa aw an naf'ala fee amwaalinaa maa nashaa'u innaka la'antal-haleemur-rasheed

footnotes.572: This is a sarcastic description implying the opposite.

ayahs.translationClear: They said, “O Shuaib, does your prayer command you that we abandon what our ancestors worshiped, or doing with our wealth what we want? You are the one who is intelligent and wise.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَـٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا‌ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ‌ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَـٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ‌ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ‌ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّيْ وَرَزَقَنِيْ مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًاؕ وَمَا͏ٓ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ اُخَالِفَكُمْ اِلٰي مَا͏ٓ اَنْهٰىكُمْ عَنْهُؕ اِنْ اُرِيْدُ اِلَّا الْاِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُؕ وَمَا تَوْفِيْقِيْٓ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِؕ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَاِلَيْهِ اُنِيْبُ

words.translation: as much as I am able
as much as I am able

ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...?[573] And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allāh. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.[574]
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee warazaqanee minhu rizqan hasanan wamaa ureedu an ukhaalifakum ilaa maa anhaakum 'anhu in ureedu illal-islaaha mastata'tu wamaa tawfeeqee illaa billaahi 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa'ilayhi uneeb

footnotes.573: The conclusion of the sentence is estimated as "...would it not be my duty to warn you against corruption and disobedience?"
footnotes.574: i.e., I turn to Allāh frequently in supplication and repentance.

ayahs.translationClear: He said, “O my people, have you considered? What if I have clear evidence from my Lord, and He has given me good livelihood from Himself? I have no desire to do what I forbid you from doing. I desire nothing but reform, as far as I can. My success lies only with Allah. In Him I trust, and to Him I turn.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِىٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَـٰلِحٍ ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِىٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَـٰلِحٍ‌ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيٰقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِيْٓ اَنْ يُّصِيْبَكُمْ مِّثْلُ مَا͏ٓ اَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ هُوْدٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ صٰلِحٍؕ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ مِّنْكُمْ بِبَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hūd or the people of Ṣāliḥ. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaaqawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqee an yuseebakum mithlu maa asaaba qawma noohin aw qawma hoodin aw qawma saalihin wamaa qawmu lootim minkum biba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: “O my people, let not your hostility towards me cause you to suffer what was suffered by the people of Noah, or the people of Hud, or the people of Saleh. The people of Lot are not far away from you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ‌ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ ۝٩٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْٓا اِلَيْهِؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ رَحِيْمٌ وَّدُوْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."
ayahs.transliteration: Wastaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee raheemun wadood
ayahs.translationClear: “And ask your Lord for forgiveness, and repent to Him. My Lord is Merciful and Loving.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا ۖ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَـٰكَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا‌ۖ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَـٰكَ‌ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ ۝٩١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا يٰشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيْرًا مِّمَّا تَقُوْلُ وَاِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيْنَا ضَعِيْفًاۚ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنٰكَؗ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيْزٍ

words.translation: surely we would have stoned you

ayahs.translation: They said, "O Shuʿayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaashu'aybu maa nafqahu katheeram mimmaa taqoolu wa'innaa lanaraaka feenaa da'eefan walawlaa rahtuka larajamnaaka wamaa anta 'alaynaa bi'azeez
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “O Shuaib, we do not understand much of what you say, and we see that you are weak among us. Were it not for your tribe, we would have stoned you. You are of no value to us.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِىٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا ۖ إِنَّ رَبِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِىٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا‌ۖ إِنَّ رَبِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ ۝٩٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اَرَهْطِيْٓ اَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُ وَرَا࢜ءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ مُحِيْطٌ
ayahs.translation: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allāh? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala yaaqawmi arahtee a'azzu 'alaykum minallaahi wattakhadhtumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyan inna rabbee bimaa ta'maloona muheet
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “O my people, is my tribe more important to you than Allah? And you have turned your backs on Him? My Lord comprehends everything you do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ ۖ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ ۖ وَٱرْتَقِبُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ‌ۖ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ‌ۖ وَٱرْتَقِبُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ ۝٩٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّيْ عَامِلٌؕ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَۙ مَنْ يَّاْتِيْهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخْزِيْهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌؕ وَارْتَقِبُوْٓا اِنِّيْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِيْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaaqawmi'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamilun sawfa ta'lamoona man ya'teehi 'adhaabun yukhzeehi waman huwa kaadhibun wartaqiboo innee ma'akum raqeeb
ayahs.translationClear: “O my people, do as you may, and so will I. You will know to whom will come a punishment that will shame him, and who is a liar. So look out; I am on the lookout with you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ ۝٩٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَّالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَاَخَذَتِ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِيْ دِيَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
ayahs.transliteration: Walammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa shu'ayban wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa wa'akhadhatil-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa'asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And when Our command came, We saved Shuaib and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and the Blast struck the wrongdoers, and they became motionless bodies in their homes.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ‌ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ ۝٩٥
ayahs.textIndopak: كَاَنْ لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيْهَاؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُوْدُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
ayahs.transliteration: Ka'al lam yaghnaw feehaa alaa bu'dal limadyana kamaa ba'idat thamood
ayahs.translationClear: As though they never flourished therein. Away with Midian, as was done away with Thamood.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٩٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority[575]
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa wasultaanim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And We sent Moses with Our signs and a clear mandate.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۖ وَمَآ أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ‌ۖ وَمَآ أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ ۝٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلٰي فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَا۟ىِٕهٖ فَاتَّبَعُوْٓا اَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَۚ وَمَا͏ٓ اَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaa fir'awna wamala'ihee fattaba'oo amra fir'awna wamaa amru fir'awna birasheed
ayahs.translationClear: To Pharaoh and his nobles, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْوِرْدُ ٱلْمَوْرُودُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ‌ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْوِرْدُ ٱلْمَوْرُودُ ۝٩٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فَاَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَؕ وَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُوْدُ
ayahs.translation: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaqdumu qawmahoo yawmal-qiyaamati fa'awradahumun-naara wabi'sal-wirdul-mawrood
ayahs.translationClear: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection, and will lead them into the Fire. Miserable is the place he placed them in.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ ۝٩٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاُتْبِعُوْا فِيْ هٰذِهٖ لَعْنَةً وَّيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِؕ بِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُوْدُ
ayahs.translation: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift[576] which is given.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'utbi'oo fee haadhihee la'natan wayawmal-qiyaamati bi'sar-rifdul-marfood

footnotes.576: i.e., the curse which follows them in both worlds.

ayahs.translationClear: They were followed by a curse in this, and on the Day of Resurrection. Miserable is the path they followed.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيْكَ ۖ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيْكَ‌ۖ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ ۝١٠٠
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنۢ͏ْبَا࢜ءِ الْقُرٰي نَقُصُّهٗ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا قَا࢜ىِٕمٌ وَّحَصِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].[577]
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika min ambaa'il-quraa naqussuhoo 'alayka minhaa qaa'imun wahaseed

footnotes.577: Their structures have been completely destroyed.

ayahs.translationClear: These are of the reports of the towns—We relate them to you. Some are still standing, and some have withered away.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۖ فَمَآ أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِى يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ‌ۖ فَمَآ أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِى يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ‌ۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ ۝١٠١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَلٰكِنْ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَا͏ٓ اَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ اٰلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِيْ يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَّمَّا جَا࢜ءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا زَادُوْهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allāh when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa zalamnaahum walaakin zalamoo anfusahum famaa aghnat 'anhum aalihatuhumul-latee yad'oona min doonillaahi min shay'il lammaa jaa'a amru rabbika wamaa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
ayahs.translationClear: We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. Their gods, whom they invoked besides Allah, availed them nothing when the command of your Lord arrived. In fact, they added only to their ruin.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَهِىَ ظَـٰلِمَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَهِىَ ظَـٰلِمَةٌ‌ۚ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ ۝١٠٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَخْذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَا͏ٓ اَخَذَ الْقُرٰي وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌؕ اِنَّ اَخْذَهٗٓ اَلِيْمٌ شَدِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhaalika akhdhu rabbika idhaa akhadhal-quraa wahiya zaalimatun inna akhdhahoo aleemun shadeed
ayahs.translationClear: Such is the grip of your Lord when He seizes the towns in the midst of their sins. His grip is most painful, most severe.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ ۝١٠٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةِؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوْعٌۙ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُوْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liman khaafa 'adhaabal-aakhirati dhaalika yawmum majmoo'ul lahun-naasu wadhaalika yawmum mashhood
ayahs.translationClear: In that is a sign for whoever fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which humanity will be gathered together—that is a Day to be witnessed.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ ۝١٠٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا نُو͏ٔ͏َخِّرُهٗٓ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعْدُوْدٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa nu'akhkhiruhoo illaa li'ajalim ma'dood
ayahs.translationClear: We only postpone it until a predetermined time.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِىٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ‌ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِىٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ ۝١٠٥
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يَاْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَّسَعِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma ya'ti laa takallamu nafsun illaa bi'idhnihee faminhum shaqiyyun wasa'eed
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when it arrives, no soul will speak without His permission. Some will be miserable, and some will be happy.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ ۝١٠٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ شَقُوْا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيْهَا زَفِيْرٌ وَّشَهِيْقٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.[578]
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'ammal-ladheena shaqoo fafin-naari lahum feehaa zafeerun washaheeq

footnotes.578: i.e., their sighs and sobs, resembling the bray of a donkey.

ayahs.translationClear: As for those who are miserable, they will be in the Fire. They will have therein sighing and wailing.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ‌ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ ۝١٠٧
ayahs.textIndopak: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَا࢜ءَ رَبُّكَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
ayahs.transliteration: Khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuka inna rabbaka fa''aalul limaa yureed
ayahs.translationClear: Remaining therein for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills. Your Lord is Doer of whatever He wills.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ ۖ عَطَآءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ‌ۖ عَطَآءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ ۝١٠٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ سُعِدُوْا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَا࢜ءَ رَبُّكَؕ عَطَا࢜ءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوْذٍ
ayahs.translation: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ammal-ladheena su'idoo fafil-jannati khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'ataa'an ghayra majdhoodh
ayahs.translationClear: And as for those who are happy, they will be in Paradise, remaining therein for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills—a reward without end.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ‌ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ‌ۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ ۝١٠٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا تَكُ فِيْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِؕ مَا يَعْبُدُوْنَ اِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ اٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُهُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلُؕ وَاِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوْهُمْ نَصِيْبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنْقُوْصٍ ࣖ

words.translation: will surely pay them in full

ayahs.translation: So do not be in doubt, [O Muḥammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa taku fee miryatim mimmaa ya'budu haa'ulaa'i maa ya'budoona illaa kamaa ya'budu aabaa'uhum min qablu wa'innaa lamuwaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
ayahs.translationClear: So be not in doubt regarding what these people worship. They worship only as their ancestors worshiped before. We will pay them their due in full, without any reduction.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ‌ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ ۝١١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَي الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِؕ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَفِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word[579] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feehi walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum wa'innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
ayahs.translationClear: We gave Moses the Scripture, but it was disputed. Were it not for a prior word from your Lord, it would have been settled between them. They are in serious doubt concerning it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ ۝١١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ اَعْمَالَهُمْؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِيْرٌ

words.translation: surely will pay them in full

ayahs.translation: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Aware of what they do.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'inna kullal lammaa layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka a'maalahum innahoo bimaa ya'maloona khabeer
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord will repay each one of them in full for their deeds. He is Aware of everything they do.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ ۝١١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا͏ٓ اُمِرْتَ وَمَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْاؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Fastaqim kamaa umirta waman taaba ma'aka walaa tatghaw innahoo bimaa ta'maloona baseer
ayahs.translationClear: So be upright, as you are commanded, along with those who repented with you, and do not transgress. He is Seeing of everything you do.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ ۝١١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوْٓا اِلَي الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُۙ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allāh any protectors; then you would not be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaa tarkanoo ilal-ladheena zalamoo fatamassakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min doonillaahi min awliyaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
ayahs.translationClear: And do not incline towards those who do wrong, or the Fire may touch you; and you will have no protectors besides Allah, and you will not be saved.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَىِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْحَسَنَـٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَىِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْحَسَنَـٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ ۝١١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّيْلِؕ اِنَّ الْحَسَنٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰي لِلذّٰكِرِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'aqimis-salaata tarafayin-nahaari wazulafam minal-layli innal-hasanaati yudhhibnas-sayyi'aati dhaalika dhikraa lidhdhaakireen
ayahs.translationClear: Perform the prayer at the borders of the day, and during the approaches of the night. The good deeds take away the bad deeds. This is a reminder for those who remember.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۝١١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاصْبِرْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيْعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
ayahs.transliteration: Wasbir fa'innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
ayahs.translationClear: And be patient. Allah will not waste the reward of the virtuous.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْفَسَادِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَآ أُتْرِفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْفَسَادِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ‌ۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَآ أُتْرِفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ ۝١١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُوْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ اُولُوْا بَقِيَّةٍ يَّنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا مِّمَّنْ اَنْجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْۚ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَا͏ٓ اُتْرِفُوْا فِيْهِ وَكَانُوْا مُجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So why were there not[580] among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: Falawlaa kaana minal-qurooni min qablikum uloo baqiyyatin yanhawna 'anil-fasaadi fil-ardi illaa qaleelam mimman anjaynaa minhum wattaba'al-ladheena zalamoo maa utrifoo feehi wakaanoo mujrimeen
ayahs.translationClear: If only there were, among the generations before you, people with wisdom, who spoke against corruption on earth—except for the few whom We saved. But the wrongdoers pursued the luxuries they were indulged in, and thus became guilty.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ ۝١١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰي بِظُلْمٍ وَّاَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa kaana rabbuka liyuhlikal-quraa bizulmin wa'ahluhaa muslihoon
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord would never destroy the towns wrongfully, while their inhabitants are righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً‌ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ ۝١١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ شَا࢜ءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلَا يَزَالُوْنَ مُخْتَلِفِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ,
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw shaa'a rabbuka laja'alan-naasa ummatan waahidatan walaa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen
ayahs.translationClear: Had your Lord willed, He could have made humanity one community, but they continue to differ.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ‌ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ‌ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝١١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَؕ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْؕ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمْلَـٔ͏َنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa mar rahima rabbuka walidhaalika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika la'amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: Except those on whom your Lord has mercy—for that reason He created them. The Word of your Lord is final: “I will fill Hell with jinn and humans, all together.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ‌ۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَنۢ͏ْبَا࢜ءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهٖ فُو͏ٔ͏َادَكَۚ وَجَا࢜ءَكَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَّذِكْرٰي لِلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakullan naqussu 'alayka min ambaa'ir-rusuli maa nuthabbitu bihee fu'aadaka wajaa'aka fee haadhihil-haqqu wamaw'izatun wadhikraa lilmu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Everything We narrate to you of the history of the messengers is to strengthen your heart therewith. The truth has come to you in this, and a lesson, and a reminder for the believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَـٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَـٰمِلُونَ ۝١٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمْؕ اِنَّا عٰمِلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqul lilladheena laa yu'minoona'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innaa 'aamiloon
ayahs.translationClear: And say to those who do not believe, “Act according to your ability; and so will we.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ ۝١٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَانْتَظِرُوْاۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
ayahs.transliteration: Wantaziroo innaa muntaziroon
ayahs.translationClear: “And wait; we too are waiting.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ‌ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْاَمْرُ كُلُّهٗ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Walillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa'ilayhi yurja'ul-amru kulluhoo fa'bud'hu watawakkal 'alayhi wamaa rabbuka bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: To Allah belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and to Him all authority goes back. So worship Him, and rely on Him. Your Lord is never unaware of what you do.
